title: mut.manual
mutation_directive: make the scene GRANDIOSE — massive scale, dramatic atmosphere, awe-inspiring. Options: vast empty plain stretching to distant horizon (ground plane scale 10x larger), colossal central form dwarfing the viewer, volumetric fog or haze in the distance that obscures the base of forms, single beam of light cutting through atmosphere (god rays), evening light quality (low sun angle, long warm shadows, slight atmospheric perspective on far forms turning them blue-grey). Think Storm King Art Center or the Sahara at sunset. Make the viewer feel small.
